context_for_next_testing_agent: Sports classification fix verified. The bug was that polymarket_scanner.py was passing only {'question': ...} to classify_market(), causing sports markets with generic questions but category='Sports' to be misclassified as 'default' and routed to HFT lane. The fix passes the full market object so TagLibraryService can use all available data (tags, category field, question). All 18 tests pass covering: category field detection (capital/lowercase), tag-based detection (nba, nfl, premier-league), HFT engine filtering, esports classification, and non-sports market verification.

bug_rca.root_cause: polymarket_scanner.py lines 300 and 492 were calling tag_library.classify_market({'question': m.get('question', '')}) - passing ONLY the question field
bug_rca.impact: Sports markets with category='Sports' in API response but generic questions (e.g., 'Will X happen?') were misclassified as 'default' and routed to HFT lane instead of SPORTS lane
bug_rca.fix_applied: Changed to pass full market object: tag_library.classify_market(m) and tag_library.classify_market(market)
bug_rca.verification: 18 pytest tests verify the fix works for all scenarios: category field, tags, HFT filtering, esports, and non-sports markets
